role: Postoutcome exploratory RGFCA-only extension. Existing G3 descriptive values were already known, so this is not confirmatory and cannot reclassify G1 or any prior result.

scope_firewall.colour_representation: the frozen four-component RGFCA colour probability vector

question: Across the 369 eligible RGFCA species, is within-species flower-colour dissimilarity positively associated with geographic distance more strongly than expected if each species retained exactly the same photographs, geography and colour-vector distribution but colour vectors were randomly reassigned among that species' coordinates?

species_statistic.name: distance_colour_spearman_rho
species_statistic.definition: Spearman correlation across all unordered photo pairs within one species between great-circle geographic distance and Jensen-Shannon divergence of the frozen four-component colour vectors.
species_statistic.continuity_with_existing_g3: Same species_distance_colour_rho estimand as frozen G3, but uses every classifiable photo of each eligible species once rather than repeated 20-photo outer draws.
species_statistic.constant_geographic_distance_rule: not evaluable; stop if any eligible species is non-evaluable rather than dropping it after outcome.

primary_global_statistic.name: equal_species_mean_rho
primary_global_statistic.definition: Arithmetic mean of the 369 species rho values, equal weight per species regardless of photo count or pair count.
primary_global_statistic.reason_for_single_primary: Avoid selecting among mean, median, positive fraction or species-count summaries after the already-known descriptive G3 direction.

secondary_descriptive_outputs: for each species, its permutation percentile and Monte Carlo upper-tail p-value, explicitly exploratory and not a prevalence estimate
BH count may be reported only as detectable-species count, never as the biological prevalence of spatial organization

exact_randomization_null.procedure: For each permutation index, independently within every species permute the complete frozen colour vectors across that species' fixed coordinates; preserve photo identities, species, coordinates, photo count, and the full within-species multiset of colour vectors exactly.
exact_randomization_null.global_null_statistic: Recompute every species rho and the equal-species mean rho for the same permutation index.
exact_randomization_null.p_value: (1 + number of 999 null mean-rho values >= observed mean rho) / 1000.
exact_randomization_null.reuse_dependencies_preserved: All classifiable photographs are used once in the observed statistic; no outer resampling is used in this extension.

implementation_efficiency_without_scient.rank_equivalence: For a species using all photos, a vertex permutation preserves the multiset of pairwise colour distances. Therefore precomputed average ranks of all pairwise JSD values may be gathered under the permuted vertex labels and Pearson-correlated with precomputed geographic-distance ranks; this is algebraically the Spearman statistic without re-sorting on every permutation.
implementation_efficiency_without_scient.sharding: Species may be partitioned into deterministic non-overlapping shards; each shard emits observed and all 999 null species rho contributions, then the finalizer reconstructs all 369-species global null values exactly.

interpretation.positive_supported_result: Evidence, conditional on the frozen RGFCA eligible/photo frame, that geographic separation and colour dissimilarity have a positive species-equal association across species. It is evidence for widespread directional spatial organization, not a claim that every species is structured and not a shared-boundary result.
interpretation.null_result: Does not establish absence of within-species spatial organization; power and heterogeneous/non-monotone spatial pattern sensitivity would remain to be quantified.

required_outputs: all 999 null global mean rho values
species/photo count audit and complete no-drop guard
independent spot-check against scipy.stats.spearmanr for observed and selected permuted species
claim_ceiling: Postoutcome exploratory RGFCA-only exact randomization evidence for a species-equal positive geographic-distance versus flower-colour-dissimilarity association. No six-species or 34-species evidence, no G1 rescue, no shared universal boundary, no environment mechanism, and no biological prevalence estimate.
